The PRIMARY authority is Condition 1 of the C2 verdict: 'The floor above is now the standard for K5 m = 5 tail adoptions, prospectively. A successor that wishes to replace it must freeze the replacement BEFORE recomputing any magnitude.' That is general to the line, states the replacement procedure, and carries a BINDING PRECONDITION. The cell-306 'replacement floor' bullet is CORROBORATING ONLY; an earlier version called it decisive, which was an over-read. What a successor may NOT do is re-adjudicate 305 or 306 under a new rule, or apply its own rule to an adoption already made.
